tldr: MCP's July 28 spec revision went stateless and added governed extensions plus hardened authorization, the biggest change since launch. Production guidance followed within a day, laying out a defense-in-depth blueprint for securing MCP gateways.
whats_new: Azure API Management shipped a dedicated AI Gateway tier in public preview, fronting Foundry, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and OpenAI behind one control plane for models, MCP servers, and tools.
why_it_matters: Cloud vendors are racing to become the governance layer for MCP traffic, so the gateway you pick now shapes which models and tools your agents can reach without a redeploy.

status.detail: Cloud vendors are shipping dedicated MCP gateway/governance tiers on top of the new spec.

beats.headline: MCP's 2026-07-28 spec goes stateless with governed extensions
beats.summary: The largest protocol revision since launch, tightening authorization.

beats.headline: InfoQ lays out a defense-in-depth blueprint for production MCP gateways
beats.summary: Four control layers: safe execution, management infrastructure, outbound controls, and monitoring.

beats.headline: Azure API Management adds a dedicated AI Gateway tier for models and MCP tools
beats.summary: A control plane built around models, MCP servers, and tools rather than APIs.

open_questions: Will AWS and Google ship comparable dedicated MCP gateway tiers, or leave governance to AgentCore/Vertex extensions?
Does Azure's AI Gateway tier enforce the new spec's hardened authorization by default, or is that left to the operator?
take_for_builders: Before reaching for a vendor gateway tier, adopt the defense-in-depth layers InfoQ outlines — a routing gateway governs traffic but doesn't by itself sandbox your MCP servers.

day_captions.b734d716b0d66f96: The spec change the rest of this thread reacts to: MCP goes stateless with governed extensions.
day_captions.9352c956aa90126f: First production security guidance written against the new spec.
day_captions.4daf9a3fc6b23a4c: Microsoft turns that guidance into a shipped product: a dedicated gateway tier for models and MCP tools.
